commit.message: feat: set the initial admin password from initAdminPassword or on a welcome page
fix: keep the login page working for sessions limited by a cross-org token
fix: align MCP request parsing and add organization LDAP password and RADIUS switches
fix: harden auto sign-in, CAS tickets, SAML signing, form CSS and WebAuthn policy
fix: change run-syncer API from GET to POST

fix: block cross-origin cookie writes, client-chosen access keys and tokens of pending sign-ins

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fix: block cross-org token escalation, CAS open service, face image SSRF and secretless refresh
fix: block captcha bypass, DCR token abuse, tenant SSRF and balance races
fix: improve authz via self-matching id and query owner
fix: authorize session APIs against sessionPkId instead of id
feat: support SAML Single Logout protocol
fix: attribute audit records of unauthenticated requests to an organization
fix: allow an org-scoped subject to update its own organization
fix: record the audit logs of M2M operations
fix: authorize get-permissions-by-submitter against the signed-in user
fix: scope application credentials to their own organization
fix: allow org admins to import groups, roles and permissions via xlsx
feat: show device, IP and last active time for each session
fix: keep the authz filter's object in sync with what controllers act on
fix: return 401 with WWW-Authenticate for MCP proxy requests
feat: implement RFC 7592 dynamic client registration management
feat: allow org admin to sync LDAP users
feat: fix bug: global admin cannot exit impersonation when impersonating a user in a different organization
feat: improve error handling in IsAllowed()
feat: enhance permission checks for org admins (#5416)
fix(authz): resolve owner/name from form data for non-JSON POST bodies
feat: improve objOwner check
fix: add provider.State to log providers
fix: fix system log provider code
fix: improve entry list page UI again
